title: OmniSource sourcing policy
description: Sourcing verdicts recorded in data/source_policy.json. Each rule documents a third-party host, repository or feed name that has been reviewed and must not become an OmniSource source, be promoted out of the discovery store, or be referenced from catalog.json. The rules are a rejection list only: the absence of a rule is not an approval.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier quoted in validation errors, CI annotations and the sourcing report.

reason.description: Why the matched sources are rejected, in terms a user can read.

hosts.description: Entries of the form 'host' (blocks the host and its subdomains) or 'host/prefix' (blocks only that path subtree).

repos.description: Forge 'owner/name' repositories, matched for github.com and raw.githubusercontent.com URLs.

nameKeywords.description: Case-insensitive substrings of a discovered source's display name.

references.description: Where the decision was made and what was observed.
